name: To all the rocks that raised me
source:
This is an afternoon. A memory. An adventure that has already happened and a reunion with myself. A love letter to Coruña and an introduction to my favorite place in the world. And a visual novel, of course. 
[From [url=https://ccglp.itch.io/to-all-the-rocks-that-raised-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个下午。一段回忆。一场已经发生的冒险和与自己的重逢。一封写给科鲁尼亚的情书，以及对世界上我最喜欢的地方的介绍。当然还有视觉小说。
[来自[url=https://ccglp.itch.io/to-all-the-rocks-that-raised-me]Itch.io[/url]]
